notes.title: Update to 1.3
notes.content:
Rework TvT and HD modes, implement controls tutorial
TvT
- arena removed
- round time set to 3 min.
- game session always open
- learn max. 4 skills + books
- removing all skills when die
- player drops a random item when die
- crystal can be taken from a chest
- central tower can be activated by crystal to quick round end.
- player can release NPCs and they follow him

HD
- concept changed, now you defend King NPC
- items qulity will grow during game
- Hired NPCs can die and follow player
- keys drop
- use keys for NPC release, it amount displaying at cage door 
- chests also increase drop grade
